## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Opt-in paging. Without `limit` or `starting_after` every matching row is returned as `{ object, data }`; `q`, `sort_by` and `field[op]` filters apply either way. With either, the response is one page with `has_more`, `next_cursor` and `total` (`limit` defaults to 50). |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous next_cursor |
| `offset` | `string` | no | The previous page's next_offset — the same token as next_cursor under a second name. Pass one of offset or starting_after, not two different values. |
| `q` | `string` | no | Matches the code |
| `sort_by[asc]` | `string` | no | Sort ascending by this field. |
| `sort_by[desc]` | `string` | no | Sort descending by this field. |
| `code` | `object` | no | Filter on `code`. Send as `code[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `status` | `object` | no | Filter on `status`. Send as `status[<operator>]=<value>`. |
| `redeemed_at` | `object` | no | Filter on `redeemed_at`. Send as `redeemed_at[<operator>]=<value>`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
